documents.title: Non-engagement letter to Sal Ferraro (draft for Andrew)

versions.author: worker
versions.content:
Dear Mr. Ferraro:

Thank you for contacting Ostrander Hale LLP on November 2, 2026 about a possible matter involving Ferraro Bakeries Inc. We have decided that we are unable to represent you or Ferraro Bakeries in this matter. We have not evaluated the merits of your potential claims, and nothing in this letter should be taken as an opinion about them.

Please be aware that claims are subject to time limits, which could bar your claims if action is not taken promptly. We encourage you to consult other counsel without delay. You have not sent us any documents, so there is nothing for us to return.

Thank you for considering our firm.

Sincerely,
Andrew Hale
